title: 山陽新幹線
summary: 以山陽新幹線的跨區域高速運輸為背景，建立連續隧道、橋梁與車站的假想剖面。學徒把列車進洞壓力、受電品質與排水維修放在同一系統邊界，分析短隧道間露天段是否改變乘坐舒適與維修需求。
summaryEn: Use the Sanyo high-speed corridor as the setting for an invented profile containing successive tunnels, bridges and stations. Place entry pressure, current collection and drainage maintenance inside one system boundary. Investigate how a short open section between tunnels can alter pressure exposure, track behaviour and access requirements without treating a simplified pressure estimate as a tunnel certification calculation.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞與高海拔壓力與氣體密度
stages.titleEn: Tunnel pressure-wave travel & Altitude pressure and air density
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「隧道壓力波傳遞」與「高海拔壓力與氣體密度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Tunnel pressure-wave travel" and "Altitude pressure and air density": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tunnel pressure-wave travel: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「隧道壓力波傳遞」如何影響山陽新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sanyo Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 列車鼻部入隧道產生壓縮擾動，壓力波以接近音速傳播而不是跟著列車速度前進。入口緩衝設計影響波形上升率，波到達出口的時間與車身到達時間屬不同問題，須分開建立量測觸發。 波傳時間由傳播距離除以聲速決定，與列車走完整段的時間不同。此式只預測到達時序而不預測波幅；洞口形狀、列車頭型和反射決定的壓力變化須用其他流動模型。 在連續隧道與洞口測點之間比較聲波傳播時間和列車通過時間，另列波幅問題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「隧道壓力波傳遞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A train nose entering a tunnel creates a compression disturbance whose propagation speed is close to acoustic speed rather than train speed. Entrance treatments affect the rise of the waveform. Wave arrival and train arrival are different events and require separate measurement triggers. Wave travel time is propagation distance divided by sound speed, not the time for the train to traverse the section. This expression predicts arrival timing, not amplitude. Portal geometry, train-nose shape and reflections require additional flow models to predict pressure changes. Compare acoustic travel time with train-passage time between tunnel and portal sensors, treating wave amplitude as a separate problem. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s；計算：travel=length/sound=7.794118 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s; calculation: travel=length/sound=7.794118 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「隧道壓力波傳遞」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tunnel pressure-wave travel”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞
knowledge.text: 列車鼻部入隧道產生壓縮擾動，壓力波以接近音速傳播而不是跟著列車速度前進。入口緩衝設計影響波形上升率，波到達出口的時間與車身到達時間屬不同問題，須分開建立量測觸發。
knowledge.textEn: A train nose entering a tunnel creates a compression disturbance whose propagation speed is close to acoustic speed rather than train speed. Entrance treatments affect the rise of the waveform.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「隧道壓力波傳遞」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tunnel pressure-wave travel" is correct?
options: 隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口
列車鼻部入隧道產生壓縮擾動，壓力波以接近音速傳播而不是跟著列車速度前進。
空氣體積流率相同就表示任何海拔的散熱質量流率相同
optionsEn: A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train.
A train nose entering a tunnel creates a compression disturbance whose propagation speed is close to acoustic speed rather than train speed.
Equal volumetric airflow guarantees equal cooling mass flow at every altitude.
quiz.explanation: 列車鼻部入隧道產生壓縮擾動，壓力波以接近音速傳播而不是跟著列車速度前進。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A train nose entering a tunnel creates a compression disturbance whose propagation speed is close to acoustic speed rather than train speed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tunnel pressure-wave travel: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「隧道壓力波傳遞」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s；計算：travel=length/sound=7.794118 s。敏感度：length 單獨增加百分之十至 2915 m，其餘固定，結果為 8.573529 s。模型邊界：一維線性聲學且音速均勻；不預測波幅、微壓波峰值或反射耗散。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s; calculation: travel=length/sound=7.794118 s. Sensitivity: length, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2915 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.573529 s. Model boundary: One-dimensional linear acoustics with uniform sound speed; amplitude, micro-pressure-wave peaks and reflection losses are not predicted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在入口與出口配置同步壓力計，用互相關估計傳遞時間，並用溫度估算音速；列車里程觸發另存一條通道。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use synchronised pressure sensors at both portals, estimate travel time by cross-correlation and sound speed from temperature, and retain train-position triggering separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s；計算：travel=length/sound=7.794118 s。敏感度：length 單獨增加百分之十至 2915 m，其餘固定，結果為 8.573529 s。模型邊界：一維線性聲學且音速均勻；不預測波幅、微壓波峰值或反射耗散。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s; calculation: travel=length/sound=7.794118 s. Sensitivity: length, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2915 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.573529 s. Model boundary: One-dimensional linear acoustics with uniform sound speed; amplitude, micro-pressure-wave peaks and reflection losses are not predicted.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「隧道壓力波傳遞」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tunnel pressure-wave travel", which statement holds?
options: 速度增加一成時制動距離必定也只增加一成
橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s。
optionsEn: A ten percent speed increase must increase braking distance by only ten percent.
Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent.
Original hypothetical exercise.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s；計算：travel=length/sound=7.794118 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s; calculation: travel=length/sound=7.794118 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tunnel pressure-wave travel: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「隧道壓力波傳遞」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在入口與出口配置同步壓力計，用互相關估計傳遞時間，並用溫度估算音速；列車里程觸發另存一條通道。 在洞口與洞內配置同步壓力測點，對照列車頭部通過時刻，分辨首波與後續反射。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use synchronised pressure sensors at both portals, estimate travel time by cross-correlation and sound speed from temperature, and retain train-position triggering separately. Synchronise pressure sensors at the portal and inside the tunnel with nose-passage time, distinguishing the first wave from later reflections. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較壓力波與列車兩種到達時間，加入一次端部反射畫出事件圖，說明單一延遲量無法判斷出口微壓波是否超標。 再以本單元 length 的對照值重算 travel，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare wave and train arrival times, add one end reflection to the event diagram, and explain why travel time alone cannot establish compliance of portal micro-pressure waves. Also recalculate travel for the alternative length value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：時間戳誤差會被誤認為波速變化；長隧道的反射波與多車事件也可能讓互相關找到錯誤的峰。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Timestamp error can imitate a wave-speed change, while reflected waves and multiple train events can make cross-correlation select the wrong peak. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在入口與出口配置同步壓力計，用互相關估計傳遞時間，並用溫度估算音速；列車里程觸發另存一條通道。 在洞口與洞內配置同步壓力測點，對照列車頭部通過時刻，分辨首波與後續反射。
knowledge.textEn: Use synchronised pressure sensors at both portals, estimate travel time by cross-correlation and sound speed from temperature, and retain train-position triggering separately. Synchronise pressure sensors at the portal and inside the tunnel with nose-passage time, distinguishing the first wave from later reflections.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較壓力波與列車兩種到達時間，加入一次端部反射畫出事件圖，說明單一延遲量無法判斷出口微壓波是否超標。 再以本單元 length 的對照值重算 travel，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare wave and train arrival times, add one end reflection to the event diagram, and explain why travel time alone cannot establish compliance of portal micro-pressure waves. Also recalculate travel for the alternative length value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「隧道壓力波傳遞」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tunnel pressure-wave travel"?
options: 在入口與出口配置同步壓力計，用互相關估計傳遞時間，並用溫度估算音速；列車里程觸發另存一條通道。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位
optionsEn: Use synchronised pressure sensors at both portals, estimate travel time by cross-correlation and sound speed from temperature, and retain train-position triggering separately.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
quiz.explanation: 在入口與出口配置同步壓力計，用互相關估計傳遞時間，並用溫度估算音速；列車里程觸發另存一條通道。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use synchronised pressure sensors at both portals, estimate travel time by cross-correlation and sound speed from temperature, and retain train-position triggering separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tunnel pressure-wave travel: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「隧道壓力波傳遞」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 時間戳誤差會被誤認為波速變化；長隧道的反射波與多車事件也可能讓互相關找到錯誤的峰。 單點峰值不足以判別首波，須檢查測點間傳遞時差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Timestamp error can imitate a wave-speed change, while reflected waves and multiple train events can make cross-correlation select the wrong peak. A single peak cannot identify the first wave; inspect propagation delay between sensors. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在連續隧道與洞口測點之間比較聲波傳播時間和列車通過時間，另列波幅問題。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare acoustic travel time with train-passage time between tunnel and portal sensors, treating wave amplitude as a separate problem.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 時間戳誤差會被誤認為波速變化；長隧道的反射波與多車事件也可能讓互相關找到錯誤的峰。 單點峰值不足以判別首波，須檢查測點間傳遞時差。
knowledge.textEn: Timestamp error can imitate a wave-speed change, while reflected waves and multiple train events can make cross-correlation select the wrong peak. A single peak cannot identify the first wave; inspect propagation delay between sensors.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「隧道壓力波傳遞」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tunnel pressure-wave travel" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
時間戳誤差會被誤認為波速變化；長隧道的反射波與多車事件也可能讓互相關找到錯誤的峰。
空氣體積流率相同就表示任何海拔的散熱質量流率相同
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Timestamp error can imitate a wave-speed change, while reflected waves and multiple train events can make cross-correlation select the wrong peak.
Equal volumetric airflow guarantees equal cooling mass flow at every altitude.
quiz.explanation: 時間戳誤差會被誤認為波速變化；長隧道的反射波與多車事件也可能讓互相關找到錯誤的峰。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Timestamp error can imitate a wave-speed change, while reflected waves and multiple train events can make cross-correlation select the wrong peak. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 高海拔壓力與氣體密度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Altitude pressure and air density: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「高海拔壓力與氣體密度」如何影響山陽新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Altitude pressure and air density” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sanyo Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 理想氣體密度由絕對壓力除氣體常數與絕對溫度決定，高海拔低壓會減少同體積空氣所攜帶的質量。這同時影響散熱和氣動力，但車廂供氧與醫療需求不能由密度公式單獨決定。 此理想氣體式以絕對壓力和絕對溫度估算空氣密度，壓力不代表氧氣比例。高原環境的密度可影響氣動和冷卻估算，但人員生理與主動加壓系統需要另外分析。 以隧道內外溫度和絕對壓力估算空氣密度，另列壓力波模型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高海拔壓力與氣體密度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ideal-gas density is absolute pressure divided by gas constant and absolute temperature. Lower pressure at altitude reduces the mass carried in a fixed air volume, affecting cooling and aerodynamic loads. Cabin oxygen provision and medical needs cannot be determined by density alone. This ideal-gas expression estimates air density from absolute pressure and temperature; pressure is not an oxygen fraction. Altitude-dependent density can affect aerodynamic and cooling estimates, while human physiology and active pressurisation require separate analysis. Estimate air density from tunnel and outside temperature and absolute pressure, separately identifying the pressure-wave model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Altitude pressure and air density” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：pressure=63600 Pa; Rair=287 J/(kg*K); temperature=280 K；計算：density=pressure/(Rair*temperature)=0.7914385 kg/m^3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: pressure=63600 Pa; Rair=287 J/(kg*K); temperature=280 K; calculation: density=pressure/(Rair*temperature)=0.7914385 kg/m^3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「空氣體積流率相同就表示任何海拔的散熱質量流率相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal volumetric airflow guarantees equal cooling mass flow at every altitude." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「高海拔壓力與氣體密度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 高海拔壓力與氣體密度
knowledge.text: 理想氣體密度由絕對壓力除氣體常數與絕對溫度決定，高海拔低壓會減少同體積空氣所攜帶的質量。這同時影響散熱和氣動力，但車廂供氧與醫療需求不能由密度公式單獨決定。
knowledge.textEn: Ideal-gas density is absolute pressure divided by gas constant and absolute temperature. Lower pressure at altitude reduces the mass carried in a fixed air volume, affecting cooling and aerodynamic loads.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：空氣體積流率相同就表示任何海拔的散熱質量流率相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal volumetric airflow guarantees equal cooling mass flow at every altitude. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高海拔壓力與氣體密度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Altitude pressure and air density" is correct?
options: 空氣體積流率相同就表示任何海拔的散熱質量流率相同
列車截面乘速度就是所有風井各自收到的相同流量
理想氣體密度由絕對壓力除氣體常數與絕對溫度決定，高海拔低壓會減少同體積空氣所攜帶的質量。
optionsEn: Equal volumetric airflow guarantees equal cooling mass flow at every altitude.
Train frontal area times speed is the identical flow received by every ventilation shaft.
Ideal-gas density is absolute pressure divided by gas constant and absolute temperature.
quiz.explanation: 理想氣體密度由絕對壓力除氣體常數與絕對溫度決定，高海拔低壓會減少同體積空氣所攜帶的質量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Ideal-gas density is absolute pressure divided by gas constant and absolute temperature. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高海拔壓力與氣體密度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Altitude pressure and air density: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高海拔壓力與氣體密度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Altitude pressure and air density” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：pressure=63600 Pa; Rair=287 J/(kg*K); temperature=280 K；計算：density=pressure/(Rair*temperature)=0.7914385 kg/m^3。敏感度：pressure 單獨增加百分之十至 69960 Pa，其餘固定，結果為 0.8705824 kg/m^3。模型邊界：乾空氣理想氣體、均勻壓溫；不計濕度與生理反應。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: pressure=63600 Pa; Rair=287 J/(kg*K); temperature=280 K; calculation: density=pressure/(Rair*temperature)=0.7914385 kg/m^3. Sensitivity: pressure, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 69960 Pa, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.8705824 kg/m^3. Model boundary: Dry ideal air at uniform pressure and temperature; humidity and physiological response are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用絕對壓力計與校正溫度計，核對感測器是否誤報表壓，並用已知風量估算質量流率檢查冷卻設計假設。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use absolute-pressure and calibrated temperature sensors, check that gauge pressure is not mistaken for absolute pressure, and compare mass flow inferred from measured volume flow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: pressure=63600 Pa; Rair=287 J/(kg*K); temperature=280 K; calculation: density=pressure/(Rair*temperature)=0.7914385 kg/m^3. Sensitivity: pressure, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 69960 Pa, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.8705824 kg/m^3. Model boundary: Dry ideal air at uniform pressure and temperature; humidity and physiological response are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 高海拔壓力與氣體密度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Altitude pressure and air density: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「高海拔壓力與氣體密度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Altitude pressure and air density” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 使用絕對壓力計與校正溫度計，核對感測器是否誤報表壓，並用已知風量估算質量流率檢查冷卻設計假設。 校正絕對壓力計並量測同位置氣溫，核對溫標換算，必要時另列濕度造成的氣體性質差異。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use absolute-pressure and calibrated temperature sensors, check that gauge pressure is not mistaken for absolute pressure, and compare mass flow inferred from measured volume flow. Calibrate the absolute-pressure sensor and measure temperature at the same location, checking the temperature conversion and separately considering humidity effects. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較兩種絕對壓力下的密度與同風量質量流率，標註溫標換算，再說明哪些車廂環境議題需要其他專業模型。 再以本單元 pressure 的對照值重算 density，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare density and mass flow at two absolute pressures, show temperature-scale conversion, and identify cabin-environment questions requiring additional specialised models. Also recalculate density for the alternative pressure value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把攝氏溫度直接代入氣體公式會產生巨大誤差；低密度時沿用海平面風量又可能不足以移除同一熱負載。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using Celsius directly in the gas equation creates a large error; at low density, sea-level volume flow may not remove the same heat load. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 使用絕對壓力計與校正溫度計，核對感測器是否誤報表壓，並用已知風量估算質量流率檢查冷卻設計假設。 校正絕對壓力計並量測同位置氣溫，核對溫標換算，必要時另列濕度造成的氣體性質差異。
knowledge.textEn: Use absolute-pressure and calibrated temperature sensors, check that gauge pressure is not mistaken for absolute pressure, and compare mass flow inferred from measured volume flow. Calibrate the absolute-pressure sensor and measure temperature at the same location, checking the temperature conversion and separately considering humidity effects.

knowledge.text: 比較兩種絕對壓力下的密度與同風量質量流率，標註溫標換算，再說明哪些車廂環境議題需要其他專業模型。 再以本單元 pressure 的對照值重算 density，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare density and mass flow at two absolute pressures, show temperature-scale conversion, and identify cabin-environment questions requiring additional specialised models. Also recalculate density for the alternative pressure value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高海拔壓力與氣體密度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Altitude pressure and air density"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
使用絕對壓力計與校正溫度計，核對感測器是否誤報表壓，並用已知風量估算質量流率檢查冷卻設計假設。

quiz.explanationEn: Use absolute-pressure and calibrated temperature sensors, check that gauge pressure is not mistaken for absolute pressure, and compare mass flow inferred from measured volume flow. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.titleEn: Altitude pressure and air density: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高海拔壓力與氣體密度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Altitude pressure and air density” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把攝氏溫度直接代入氣體公式會產生巨大誤差；低密度時沿用海平面風量又可能不足以移除同一熱負載。 若使用攝氏溫度直接作分母，空氣密度會失去正確物理意義。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using Celsius directly in the gas equation creates a large error; at low density, sea-level volume flow may not remove the same heat load. Using Celsius temperature directly in the denominator produces a physically incorrect air density. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以隧道內外溫度和絕對壓力估算空氣密度，另列壓力波模型。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Estimate air density from tunnel and outside temperature and absolute pressure, separately identifying the pressure-wave model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「空氣體積流率相同就表示任何海拔的散熱質量流率相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal volumetric airflow guarantees equal cooling mass flow at every altitude." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
